REQUEST FOR PROPOSAL
REF#: NCD-CP-2025-09
PROCUREMENT FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF 
NCD PREVENTION AND CONTROL PROGRAMME 
STANDARD OPERATIONAL MANUAL
Ministry of Health & Wellness now invites bids from eligible 
and qualified individual consultants to provide consulting 
services to develop a user-friendly, evidence-based, locally 
relevant Standard Operational Manual that will serve as a 
practical guide for programme managers and coordinators 
responsible for implementing NCD prevention and control 
interventions at the national, regional and parish levels.
Bidding will be conducted through the Restrictive Bidding 
(RB) Procedures specified in the Government of Jamaica’s 
procurement policies.
Eligibility Requirements:
Bidders must submit the following with their bids at the time 
of bid opening:
•	
A copy of a valid  Tax Compliance Certificate (TCC) or a 
Valid Tax Compliance Letter (TCL) 
•	
A copy of your Postgraduate Degree in Public Health, 
Business Administration, or related discipline. 
All other instructions and requirements will be in the bid 
document. Tender submissions that do not comply with all 
the above requirements will be deemed non-responsive.
Availability of Bid Document and Bid Submission: 
This is an online tender where tender documents, clarifications 
and bid submission will only be made available and accepted 
via the Government of Jamaica Electronic Portal – GOJEP 
(www.gojep.gov.jm). No offline (hard copies) will be 
accepted and there will be no physical drop box for drop-off 
of tender documents.
•	
Tender documents can be downloaded as of Monday, 
December 1, 2025.
•	
Clarification period for queries and responses closes – 
Monday, December 8, 2025 no later than 3:00 p.m.
Submission Deadline:
Tenders must be submitted via the GOJEP no later than 
Monday, December 15, 2025 at 3:00 p.m. local time.
Late bids will be automatically rejected by the system. 
To participate in this tender opportunity, suppliers must first 
be registered on the GOJEP at www.gojep.gov.jm. 
To register, please select the “Register as a supplier” link 
from the GOJEP system’s home page.
For assistance regarding training, registration, download of 
tender documents and upload of tender proposals, please 
contact the Ministry of Finance and the Public Service, the 
Office of Public Procurement Policy Customer Care Desk at  
876-932-5220/932-5246/932-5253/932-5251/932-5244 or 
email at opppcustomercare@mof.gov.jm.  
This advertisement can also be viewed on the Ministry of 
Health & Wellness website at www.moh.gov.jm.
The Ministry of Health & Wellness reserves the right to 
accept or reject any tenders or to abandon the tender 
process without any explanation to prospective bidders.--------------------------------------------------------------------------------
